name: APC sim — lead router to Airtable CRM

parameters.jsCode: return $input.first().json.leads.map((lead) => ({ json: { lead_id: lead.lead_id, raw: lead.raw } }));

const parsed = JSON.parse($json.raw);
return { json: { lead_id: $json.lead_id, ...parsed } };

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ performUpsert: { fieldsToMergeOn: ['Email'] }, records: [ { fields: { 'Email': $json.email, 'Lead ID': $json.lead_id, 'Name': $json.name, 'Budget': $json.budget, 'Source': $json.source, 'Score': $json.score, 'Tier': $json.tier } } ] }) }}
